description: This file defines GoalsFragment, a DialogFragment subclass used to display and edit user fitness goals within an Android application. It constructs a dialog with input fields for weekly workouts and target calories, retrieves current goal data from a mock repository, and updates the goal based on user input.

classes.name: GoalsFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for editing user fitness goals, providing input fields for weekly workouts and target calories, and updating the goal data in the repository.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns a dialog allowing users to view and edit their fitness goals, with options to save or cancel changes.
